summary: Wrote a 6-phase, ~9h plan coupling capture.projects[].enabled bidirectionally to .extensions.sapience.status. Architecture: two new standalone actions on setup-sapience-mcp.sh (--capture-set on|off, --reap-capture) wrapping SAPIENCE_NO_CAPTURE_SYNC=1 timeout 15 sapience projects on|off, invoked from the existing SessionStart hook's two branches and its ungated reap pass; this needs zero installer and zero manifest change because the installer already seeds that writer to ~/.claude/scripts/. All eight trigger-class premises in the dispatch description were re-validated against the research report and live state and all hold. Two gaps are carried as explicit Non-Goals with operator follow-ups recorded in Phase 6: the legacy folders list (a second upstream gate no vendor CLI can safely grow non-interactively, and sf1-engine is in neither list today) and the byte-identical ~/.dotfiles companion copy, which is a different repository.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: writer --capture-set action, writer --reap-capture sweep, hook wiring plus caveats, verifier check (i) WARN, per-repo-scoping.md rewrite with the folders double-gate, then redeploy and operator handoff.
